links.outcome: AI classification accuracy versus blinded electrophysiologist adjudication on random ~15% sample of transmissions
links.effect: Against electrophysiologist gold standard, AI was 93.8% accurate with 99.1% sensitivity, 93% specificity, and F1 score of 81%.
links.quote: Considering electrophysiologist interpretation/adjudication as the gold standard, AI was 93.8% accurate with 99.1% sensitivity, 93% specificity, and an F1 score of 81%.

unlisted_practices: Using AI to triage and filter cardiac implantable device remote monitoring transmissions to reduce data burden on device clinics

screen.reason: The study evaluates a real-world deployment of an AI system triaging and interpreting cardiac implantable electronic device remote monitoring data across 78 clinics, but evaluates diagnostic accuracy and workload reduction rather than testing an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
